panels.description: Fires when any dead letter queue has messages sitting in it for more than 5 minutes. Indicates failed message processing that needs investigation.

alert.name: Dead Letter Queue Growth
alert.message: Dead letter queue {{ $labels.queue_name }} in {{ $labels.environment }} has {{ $value }} messages. Failed messages need immediate investigation.

panels.title: 🔴 Dead Letter Queue Messages

panels.description: Fires when any queue has more than 1000 messages for 10 minutes. May indicate consumer issues or traffic spike.

alert.name: Queue Depth Spike
alert.message: Queue {{ $labels.queue_name }} in {{ $labels.environment }} has {{ $value }} messages (threshold: 1000). Check consumer health.

panels.title: 🟡 Queue Depth Spike

panels.description: Fires when in-flight messages exceed 500 for 5 minutes. Consumers may be struggling to process messages.

alert.name: High In-Flight Messages
alert.message: Queue {{ $labels.queue_name }} has {{ $value }} in-flight messages (threshold: 500). Consumers may be struggling.

panels.title: 🟡 High In-Flight Messages

panels.description: Fires when a queue has messages but zero acknowledgments for 30 minutes. No consumers may be processing.

alert.name: Stale Queue - No Consumer Activity
alert.message: Queue {{ $labels.queue_name }} has messages but no acknowledgments for 30 minutes. Check if consumers are running.

panels.title: 🟡 Stale Queue (Messages, No Acks)

panels.description: Fires when the exporter encounters scrape errors in the last 15 minutes.

alert.name: Exporter Scrape Errors
alert.message: Anypoint MQ exporter is experiencing scrape errors. Check exporter logs and Anypoint Platform connectivity.

panels.title: ℹ️ Scrape Errors
Estimated Queue Wait Time (depth ÷ consumption rate)
panels.description: Estimates how long a new message would wait in queue based on current depth and consumption rate. Higher = slower processing.

panels.title: Queue Depth Velocity (rate of change)
panels.description: Positive = queue growing, Negative = queue draining. Shows acceleration/deceleration of message backlog.

panels.title: Send vs Receive Rate
panels.description: Compares message production rate to consumption rate. Gap = backlog building.

panels.title: DLQ Ratio (% of total messages)
panels.description: Percentage of messages ending up in dead letter queues vs total throughput. High ratio = systemic processing failures.
